content: आह्वयः .²1 A name, appellation (as last member of <ab>comp.</ab>); काव्यं रामायणाह्वयम् <ls>Rām.</ls>; चकसाह्वयम्, चरणाह्वयाः; वृद्धेरप्याह्वया इमे <ls>Ak.</ls> .²2 A law-suit arising from a dispute about games with animals, as cock-fighting <ab>&c.</ab>; (one of the 18 titles of law); पणपूर्वकपक्षिमेषादियोधनम् आह्वयः Rāghavānanda on <ls>Ms. 8. 7</ls>.
